zoe_marketing: Quick debrief  Orchard Labs interview done this morning. Recording + transcript in Drive: https://drive.redwood/orchard. Captured a nice anecdote about switching to Dedicated during holiday spikes. Need: quote approval, media release, and webinar copy. Target embargo: Nov 18.

kai_growth: Love the holiday spikes angle. Growth wants CTA to route webinar registrants to the mid-market demo flow and tag with orchard-web.

marta_prod: We can produce a P95 before/after chart from their logs; will need Orchard to sign off on any % numbers. I also have a short technical soundbite from their infra lead.

julien_legal: Please upload the signed release. Reminder: no raw customer metrics without explicit written approval. Ill send a short approval template to their counsel for any numeric claims.

zoe_marketing: Release uploaded and I dropped three quote options in the folder: exec, product, and concise headline. Link: https://drive.redwood/orchard/quotes. /cc @julien_legal

ia_design: Once copy is locked Ill make a hero banner + 30s social clip. Need final CTA and embargo to set the promo schedule.

leo_sales: Routing: utm=orchard_launch; tag registrants with "prospect:midmarket". AE follow-up: reach out within 48h for attendees who request a demo. Also want a gated appendix with full charts for enterprise handoff.

upload-bot: Reminder: marketing asset freeze at timestamp 1799985600 (Nov 16 20:00 UTC).

julien_legal: If Orchard wants to avoid exact figures, we can publish qualitative language like "reduced tail latency" and use a sanitized chart without tick labels. If they approve numbers, send the explicit stat via email to me.

kai_growth: Plan B: headline "How Orchard kept latency steady during holiday peaks" and secondary CTA "Get the full case notes (sales)". That still drives lead capture.

marta_prod: Derek (Orchard infra) said hell ask finance for a one-line stat. ETA Friday. If they decline, well publish qualitative copy and offer the detailed appendix gated for sales.

zoe_marketing: Sounds good. Action items: 1) @julien_legal send approval template to Orchard counsel, 2) @marta_prod prepare sanitized chart mock, 3) @ia_design mock hero variants. Ill lock promo copy once quote + legal OK. Will post final assets here. :seedling:
